summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Avantis International Large Cap Value ETF (AVIV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund primarily investing in non-US developed market equities with lower prices relative to their book values. AVIV was launched on Sep 28, 2021 and is issued by American Century Investments.

holdings.infoBox: AVIV is an equity ETF with a total of 620 individual holdings. The top holdings are Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria stock at 2.56%, Shell at 2.04%, Safran at 2.02%, Roche Holding AG at 1.80%, and Zurich Insurance Group AG at 1.39%.
